RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 20

An all-women panel is not evidence of anything on its own. In education, women are the majority of teachers and administrators, so same-sex panels occur constantly by chance; they also frequently select men. Leading with it makes you look like you're hunting for a grievance rather than contesting a decision — and it weakens the argument you actually have.

Your strong ground is concrete: your master's in educational leadership and five years as deputy principal against "courses in school leadership," plus an unanswered statutory-type request for written reasons after two weeks. Follow up in writing, cite the deadline, and ask how leadership qualifications and experience were weighted.

If the reasons, once given, don't add up, escalate on the merits.
